body.Title: measures
body.Description: One row per measure. Retired measures stay, with their history.

body.Title: measure_code
body.Description: System key, e.g. PM-0001. Unique. Every other table links on this.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="measure_name" StaticName="measure_name" DisplayName="measure_name" Description="Short name of the measure." Required="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Text" Name="source_ref" StaticName="source_ref" DisplayName="source_ref" Description="Reference used in the source document, e.g. 1.01. Not unique: parent and child can share it." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="source_document" StaticName="source_document" DisplayName="source_document" Description="Document or framework the measure comes from." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Text" Name="parent_measure_code" StaticName="parent_measure_code" DisplayName="parent_measure_code" Description="measure_code of the parent summary measure. Blank for top-level measures." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Note" Name="description" StaticName="description" DisplayName="description" Description="What the measure tells you, in plain English." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>

<Field Type="Note" Name="definition" StaticName="definition" DisplayName="definition" Description="Definition and calculation method." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="measure_class" StaticName="measure_class" DisplayName="measure_class" Description="measure, kpi or okr. Tolerance only applies to kpi and okr." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><Default>measure</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>measure</CHOICE><CHOICE>kpi</CHOICE><CHOICE>okr</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="measure_type" StaticName="measure_type" DisplayName="measure_type" Description="summary, output or outcome." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><Default>output</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>summary</CHOICE><CHOICE>output</CHOICE><CHOICE>outcome</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="unit" StaticName="unit" DisplayName="unit" Description="Unit of the value. percent is stored as 0 to 100 (58 means 58%). gbp is pounds. yes_no is stored as 1 or 0." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>number</CHOICE><CHOICE>percent</CHOICE><CHOICE>gbp</CHOICE><CHOICE>count</CHOICE><CHOICE>yes_no</CHOICE><CHOICE>text</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="Number" Name="decimal_places" StaticName="decimal_places" DisplayName="decimal_places" Description="Decimal places to show. Does not change the stored value." Required="FALSE" Decimals="0"><Default>0</Default></Field>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="polarity" StaticName="polarity" DisplayName="polarity" Description="Which direction is good. Used for RAG." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>higher_is_better</CHOICE><CHOICE>lower_is_better</CHOICE><CHOICE>neither</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="frequency" StaticName="frequency" DisplayName="frequency" Description="How often a value is recorded." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>daily</CHOICE><CHOICE>weekly</CHOICE><CHOICE>fortnightly</CHOICE><CHOICE>monthly</CHOICE><CHOICE>quarterly</CHOICE><CHOICE>annual</CHOICE><CHOICE>calendar_year</CHOICE><CHOICE>academic_year</CHOICE><CHOICE>term</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="aggregation_method" StaticName="aggregation_method" DisplayName="aggregation_method" Description="How to roll values up to a longer period, e.g. monthly to quarterly. do_not_combine for values that must not be added or averaged." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><Default>do_not_combine</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>sum</CHOICE><CHOICE>average</CHOICE><CHOICE>latest</CHOICE><CHOICE>max</CHOICE><CHOICE>min</CHOICE><CHOICE>do_not_combine</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="Number" Name="expected_lag_days" StaticName="expected_lag_days" DisplayName="expected_lag_days" Description="Usual days after period end before data is available. Blank means no expectation, so it is never flagged as late." Required="FALSE" Decimals="0"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="category" StaticName="category" DisplayName="category" Description="Category code from the lookups list." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="data_source" StaticName="data_source" DisplayName="data_source" Description="Where the data comes from." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="org_unit_key" StaticName="org_unit_key" DisplayName="org_unit_key" Description="Team that owns the measure." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="status" StaticName="status" DisplayName="status" Description="active or retired. Measures are never deleted." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><Default>active</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>active</CHOICE><CHOICE>retired</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="retired_date" StaticName="retired_date" DisplayName="retired_date" Description="Date the measure was retired." Required="FALSE" Format="DateOnly"/>

<Field Type="Note" Name="retired_reason" StaticName="retired_reason" DisplayName="retired_reason" Description="Why the measure was retired." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>

body.Title: periods
body.Description: Central calendar. Every value joins to one period. Term rows are edited here by admins.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Choice" Name="period_type" StaticName="period_type" DisplayName="period_type" Description="Matches a measure frequency." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>daily</CHOICE><CHOICE>weekly</CHOICE><CHOICE>fortnightly</CHOICE><CHOICE>monthly</CHOICE><CHOICE>quarterly</CHOICE><CHOICE>annual</CHOICE><CHOICE>calendar_year</CHOICE><CHOICE>academic_year</CHOICE><CHOICE>term</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="Text" Name="period_label" StaticName="period_label" DisplayName="period_label" Description="Display label, e.g. Q2 2026-27 or Autumn Term 2026." Required="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="start_date" StaticName="start_date" DisplayName="start_date" Description="First day of the period." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="DateOnly"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="end_date" StaticName="end_date" DisplayName="end_date" Description="Last day of the period." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="DateOnly"/>

<Field Type="Text" Name="financial_year" StaticName="financial_year" DisplayName="financial_year" Description="UK financial year (April to March) containing the start date, e.g. 2026-27." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Text" Name="financial_quarter" StaticName="financial_quarter" DisplayName="financial_quarter" Description="Financial quarter containing the start date, e.g. 2026-27 Q2. Blank for periods longer than a quarter." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Text" Name="academic_year" StaticName="academic_year" DisplayName="academic_year" Description="Academic year (September to August) containing the start date." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Number" Name="calendar_year" StaticName="calendar_year" DisplayName="calendar_year" Description="Calendar year containing the start date." Required="FALSE" Decimals="0"/>

body.Title: measure_roles
body.Description: Who owns, updates and approves each measure. A measure can have several updaters.

body.Title: role_key
body.Description: measure_code|email|role. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="measure_code" StaticName="measure_code" DisplayName="measure_code" Description="Measure." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="email" StaticName="email" DisplayName="email" Description="Person." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="role" StaticName="role" DisplayName="role" Description="owner, updater or approver." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>owner</CHOICE><CHOICE>updater</CHOICE><CHOICE>approver</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="Boolean" Name="active" StaticName="active" DisplayName="active" Description="Only active roles give access." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE"><Default>1</Default></Field>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="start_date" StaticName="start_date" DisplayName="start_date" Description="Role start." Required="FALSE" Format="DateOnly"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="end_date" StaticName="end_date" DisplayName="end_date" Description="Role end." Required="FALSE" Format="DateOnly"/>

body.Title: groups
body.Description: Themes, programmes and objectives that measures and work contribute to.

body.Title: group_key
body.Description: Group key, e.g. TH-JOBS. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="group_name" StaticName="group_name" DisplayName="group_name" Description="Name of the theme, programme or objective." Required="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="group_type" StaticName="group_type" DisplayName="group_type" Description="theme, programme or objective." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>theme</CHOICE><CHOICE>programme</CHOICE><CHOICE>objective</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="Note" Name="description" StaticName="description" DisplayName="description" Description="What it covers." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>
<Field Type="Boolean" Name="active" StaticName="active" DisplayName="active" Description="Inactive groups are hidden from new entries." Required="FALSE"><Default>1</Default></Field>

body.Title: measure_links
body.Description: Many-to-many links between measures and groups.

body.Title: link_key
body.Description: measure_code|group_key. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="measure_code" StaticName="measure_code" DisplayName="measure_code" Description="Measure." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="group_key" StaticName="group_key" DisplayName="group_key" Description="Group." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="relationship_type" StaticName="relationship_type" DisplayName="relationship_type" Description="primary, contributes_to or related." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>primary</CHOICE><CHOICE>contributes_to</CHOICE><CHOICE>related</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="Boolean" Name="active" StaticName="active" DisplayName="active" Description="Inactive links are kept for history." Required="FALSE"><Default>1</Default></Field>

body.Title: reference_values
body.Description: Optional targets, tolerances, baselines and capacities. Zero or more per measure per period.

body.Title: ref_key
body.Description: measure_code|period_key|ref_type. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="measure_code" StaticName="measure_code" DisplayName="measure_code" Description="Measure." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="period_key" StaticName="period_key" DisplayName="period_key" Description="Period." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="ref_type" StaticName="ref_type" DisplayName="ref_type" Description="target, tolerance, baseline or capacity. tolerance only for kpi and okr measures." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>target</CHOICE><CHOICE>tolerance</CHOICE><CHOICE>baseline</CHOICE><CHOICE>capacity</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="Number" Name="ref_value" StaticName="ref_value" DisplayName="ref_value" Description="The reference value, in the measure's unit." Required="TRUE"/>
<Field Type="Note" Name="notes" StaticName="notes" DisplayName="notes" Description="Where the value came from." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>
<Field Type="Boolean" Name="active" StaticName="active" DisplayName="active" Description="Inactive values are ignored." Required="FALSE"><Default>1</Default></Field>

body.Title: submissions
body.Description: One row per measure per period. Created as not_started when the period ends.

body.Title: submission_key
body.Description: measure_code|period_key. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="measure_code" StaticName="measure_code" DisplayName="measure_code" Description="Measure." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="period_key" StaticName="period_key" DisplayName="period_key" Description="Period the data relates to." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="status" StaticName="status" DisplayName="status" Description="not_started, draft, submitted, returned or approved." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><Default>not_started</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>not_started</CHOICE><CHOICE>draft</CHOICE><CHOICE>submitted</CHOICE><CHOICE>returned</CHOICE><CHOICE>approved</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="DateTime" Name="expected_by" StaticName="expected_by" DisplayName="expected_by" Description="Period end plus the measure's expected lag. Blank if no lag is set." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="DateOnly"/>

<Field Type="Number" Name="current_version" StaticName="current_version" DisplayName="current_version" Description="Latest version number. 0 before anything is entered." Required="FALSE" Decimals="0"><Default>0</Default></Field>

<Field Type="Number" Name="approved_version" StaticName="approved_version" DisplayName="approved_version" Description="Version used in reports. Blank until first approval." Required="FALSE" Decimals="0"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="submitted_date" StaticName="submitted_date" DisplayName="submitted_date" Description="When the latest version was submitted." Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="approved_by" StaticName="approved_by" DisplayName="approved_by" Description="Email of the approver." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="approved_date" StaticName="approved_date" DisplayName="approved_date" Description="When it was approved." Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime"/>

body.Title: submission_versions
body.Description: Every version of every value. Drafts are edited in place; each resubmission after a return is a new version.

body.Title: version_key
body.Description: submission_key|v<version_no>. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="submission_key" StaticName="submission_key" DisplayName="submission_key" Description="Submission." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Text" Name="measure_code" StaticName="measure_code" DisplayName="measure_code" Description="Measure (copied from the submission for filtering)." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="period_key" StaticName="period_key" DisplayName="period_key" Description="Period (copied from the submission for filtering)." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Number" Name="version_no" StaticName="version_no" DisplayName="version_no" Description="1, 2, 3 and so on." Required="TRUE" Decimals="0"/>
<Field Type="Number" Name="value_number" StaticName="value_number" DisplayName="value_number" Description="The value for all units except text. percent 0 to 100, yes_no 1 or 0." Required="FALSE"/>

<Field Type="Note" Name="value_text" StaticName="value_text" DisplayName="value_text" Description="The value for text measures only." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>

<Field Type="Boolean" Name="value_missing" StaticName="value_missing" DisplayName="value_missing" Description="Yes if no value could be provided. Narrative then required." Required="FALSE"><Default>0</Default></Field>

<Field Type="Note" Name="narrative" StaticName="narrative" DisplayName="narrative" Description="Updater's commentary. Required if the value is missing or off track." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="data_quality" StaticName="data_quality" DisplayName="data_quality" Description="verified, provisional, estimated or unverified." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><Default>unverified</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>verified</CHOICE><CHOICE>provisional</CHOICE><CHOICE>estimated</CHOICE><CHOICE>unverified</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="Text" Name="entered_by" StaticName="entered_by" DisplayName="entered_by" Description="Email of the updater." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="entered_date" StaticName="entered_date" DisplayName="entered_date" Description="When the value was first entered." Required="TRUE" Format="DateTime"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="submitted_date" StaticName="submitted_date" DisplayName="submitted_date" Description="When this version was submitted." Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="version_status" StaticName="version_status" DisplayName="version_status" Description="draft, submitted, returned, approved or superseded. Only approved versions flow into reports." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><Default>draft</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>draft</CHOICE><CHOICE>submitted</CHOICE><CHOICE>returned</CHOICE><CHOICE>approved</CHOICE><CHOICE>superseded</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="rag_status" StaticName="rag_status" DisplayName="rag_status" Description="RAG worked out at approval using polarity and the period's target and tolerance." Required="FALSE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>green</CHOICE><CHOICE>amber</CHOICE><CHOICE>red</CHOICE><CHOICE>no_target</CHOICE><CHOICE>no_data</CHOICE><CHOICE>not_applicable</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

body.Title: review_comments
body.Description: Reviewer feedback, kept apart from the narrative. Internal only: excluded from standard exports.

body.Title: comment_ref
body.Description: Reference, e.g. RC-00001.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="submission_key" StaticName="submission_key" DisplayName="submission_key" Description="Submission." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Number" Name="version_no" StaticName="version_no" DisplayName="version_no" Description="Version the comment was made on." Required="TRUE" Decimals="0"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="reviewer_email" StaticName="reviewer_email" DisplayName="reviewer_email" Description="Reviewer." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="action" StaticName="action" DisplayName="action" Description="returned, approved, reopened or comment. Returning and reopening need a comment." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>returned</CHOICE><CHOICE>approved</CHOICE><CHOICE>reopened</CHOICE><CHOICE>comment</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="Note" Name="comment" StaticName="comment" DisplayName="comment" Description="The comment. Required when returning." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="comment_date" StaticName="comment_date" DisplayName="comment_date" Description="When the comment was made." Required="TRUE" Format="DateTime"/>
<Field Type="Boolean" Name="resolved" StaticName="resolved" DisplayName="resolved" Description="Yes once the updater has dealt with it." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE"><Default>0</Default></Field>
<Field Type="Text" Name="resolved_by" StaticName="resolved_by" DisplayName="resolved_by" Description="Who marked it resolved." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="resolved_date" StaticName="resolved_date" DisplayName="resolved_date" Description="When it was resolved." Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime"/>

body.Title: org_units
body.Description: Workstream, team and sub-team hierarchy. Feeds every team dropdown.

body.Title: org_unit_key
body.Description: Key, e.g. WS-JOBS, TM-SDS, ST-SDS-A. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="unit_name" StaticName="unit_name" DisplayName="unit_name" Description="Name as people know it." Required="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="unit_level" StaticName="unit_level" DisplayName="unit_level" Description="workstream, team or sub_team." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>workstream</CHOICE><CHOICE>team</CHOICE><CHOICE>sub_team</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="Text" Name="parent_key" StaticName="parent_key" DisplayName="parent_key" Description="Parent unit. Blank for workstreams." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Boolean" Name="active" StaticName="active" DisplayName="active" Description="Inactive units are hidden from new entries." Required="FALSE"><Default>1</Default></Field>

body.Title: people
body.Description: Everyone who uses the system.

body.Title: email
body.Description: Work email, lower case. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="display_name" StaticName="display_name" DisplayName="display_name" Description="Name shown in the app." Required="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="org_unit_key" StaticName="org_unit_key" DisplayName="org_unit_key" Description="Default team. Pre-fills the weekly update." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Text" Name="line_manager_email" StaticName="line_manager_email" DisplayName="line_manager_email" Description="Line manager. Only they can see this person's individual wellbeing responses." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="app_role" StaticName="app_role" DisplayName="app_role" Description="admin, standard or viewer. Measure rights come from measure_roles." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><Default>standard</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>admin</CHOICE><CHOICE>standard</CHOICE><CHOICE>viewer</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="Boolean" Name="active" StaticName="active" DisplayName="active" Description="Leavers are made inactive, never deleted." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE"><Default>1</Default></Field>

body.Title: weekly_updates
body.Description: One row per person per week: successes, communication and workload.

body.Title: update_key
body.Description: email|week_start. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="email" StaticName="email" DisplayName="email" Description="Person." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="week_start" StaticName="week_start" DisplayName="week_start" Description="Monday of the week." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="DateOnly"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="org_unit_key" StaticName="org_unit_key" DisplayName="org_unit_key" Description="Team at the time of the update." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Note" Name="successes" StaticName="successes" DisplayName="successes" Description="Successes had or heard about." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>

<Field Type="Note" Name="communication" StaticName="communication" DisplayName="communication" Description="Anything that would help if more widely known." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="workload" StaticName="workload" DisplayName="workload" Description="light, manageable, heavy or overloaded." Required="FALSE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>light</CHOICE><CHOICE>manageable</CHOICE><CHOICE>heavy</CHOICE><CHOICE>overloaded</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="submitted_at" StaticName="submitted_at" DisplayName="submitted_at" Description="When it was saved." Required="TRUE" Format="DateTime"/>

body.Title: wellbeing_checkins
body.Description: RESTRICTED. Individual wellbeing, visible only to the person's line manager. People see team counts only. Never exported or sent to AI.

body.Title: checkin_key
body.Description: email|week_start. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="email" StaticName="email" DisplayName="email" Description="Person." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Text" Name="line_manager_email" StaticName="line_manager_email" DisplayName="line_manager_email" Description="Line manager at the time of the check-in. Only they can see it. Blank if the person has no line manager, so only they see it." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="org_unit_key" StaticName="org_unit_key" DisplayName="org_unit_key" Description="Team at the time, for team counts." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="week_start" StaticName="week_start" DisplayName="week_start" Description="Monday of the week." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="DateOnly"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="wellbeing" StaticName="wellbeing" DisplayName="wellbeing" Description="thriving, ok or struggling." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>thriving</CHOICE><CHOICE>ok</CHOICE><CHOICE>struggling</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="Note" Name="comments" StaticName="comments" DisplayName="comments" Description="Optional comments." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="submitted_at" StaticName="submitted_at" DisplayName="submitted_at" Description="When it was saved." Required="TRUE" Format="DateTime"/>

body.Title: tasks
body.Description: One row per task for its whole life. Open tasks carry over each week; nobody re-enters them.

body.Title: task_code
body.Description: Key, e.g. TSK-00001. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="task_name" StaticName="task_name" DisplayName="task_name" Description="What needs doing." Required="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="priority" StaticName="priority" DisplayName="priority" Description="must, should or could." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>must</CHOICE><CHOICE>should</CHOICE><CHOICE>could</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="Text" Name="org_unit_key" StaticName="org_unit_key" DisplayName="org_unit_key" Description="Team." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="contributes_to_type" StaticName="contributes_to_type" DisplayName="contributes_to_type" Description="group or measure. Blank if it doesn't contribute to anything specific." Required="FALSE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>group</CHOICE><CHOICE>measure</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="Text" Name="contributes_to_key" StaticName="contributes_to_key" DisplayName="contributes_to_key" Description="group_key or measure_code this work supports." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Note" Name="contributes_to_note" StaticName="contributes_to_note" DisplayName="contributes_to_note" Description="Optional extra detail on the aim." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="raised_by" StaticName="raised_by" DisplayName="raised_by" Description="Who added it." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="date_raised" StaticName="date_raised" DisplayName="date_raised" Description="When it was added." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="DateOnly"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="assigned_to" StaticName="assigned_to" DisplayName="assigned_to" Description="Who is doing it." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="status" StaticName="status" DisplayName="status" Description="open, complete or cancelled." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><Default>open</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>open</CHOICE><CHOICE>complete</CHOICE><CHOICE>cancelled</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="Text" Name="completed_by" StaticName="completed_by" DisplayName="completed_by" Description="Who completed it." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="DateTime" Name="completed_date" StaticName="completed_date" DisplayName="completed_date" Description="When it was completed or cancelled." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="DateOnly"/>
<Field Type="Note" Name="notes" StaticName="notes" DisplayName="notes" Description="Notes." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>

body.Title: problems
body.Description: One row per problem for its whole life. Open problems carry over each week.

body.Title: problem_code
body.Description: Key, e.g. PRB-00001. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="problem_title" StaticName="problem_title" DisplayName="problem_title" Description="Short title." Required="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Note" Name="problem_statement" StaticName="problem_statement" DisplayName="problem_statement" Description="What the problem is." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="org_unit_key" StaticName="org_unit_key" DisplayName="org_unit_key" Description="Team." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="raised_by" StaticName="raised_by" DisplayName="raised_by" Description="Who raised it." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="raised_on" StaticName="raised_on" DisplayName="raised_on" Description="When it was raised." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="DateOnly"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="problem_owner" StaticName="problem_owner" DisplayName="problem_owner" Description="Who owns resolving it." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="impact" StaticName="impact" DisplayName="impact" Description="low, medium or high." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>low</CHOICE><CHOICE>medium</CHOICE><CHOICE>high</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="urgency" StaticName="urgency" DisplayName="urgency" Description="low, medium or high." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>low</CHOICE><CHOICE>medium</CHOICE><CHOICE>high</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="DateTime" Name="target_resolution_date" StaticName="target_resolution_date" DisplayName="target_resolution_date" Description="When it should be resolved by." Required="FALSE" Format="DateOnly"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="status" StaticName="status" DisplayName="status" Description="open or closed." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><Default>open</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>open</CHOICE><CHOICE>closed</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="closed_date" StaticName="closed_date" DisplayName="closed_date" Description="When it was closed." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="DateOnly"/>
<Field Type="Note" Name="resolution" StaticName="resolution" DisplayName="resolution" Description="How it was resolved." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="contributes_to_type" StaticName="contributes_to_type" DisplayName="contributes_to_type" Description="group or measure. Blank if it doesn't contribute to anything specific." Required="FALSE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>group</CHOICE><CHOICE>measure</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="Text" Name="contributes_to_key" StaticName="contributes_to_key" DisplayName="contributes_to_key" Description="group_key or measure_code affected." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Note" Name="notes" StaticName="notes" DisplayName="notes" Description="Context." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>

body.Title: lookups
body.Description: Editable pick lists that change over time, such as categories.

body.Title: lookup_key
body.Description: lookup_type|code. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Choice" Name="lookup_type" StaticName="lookup_type" DisplayName="lookup_type" Description="Which pick list." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>category</CHOICE><CHOICE>data_source</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="Text" Name="code" StaticName="code" DisplayName="code" Description="Stored code." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="label" StaticName="label" DisplayName="label" Description="Label shown to people." Required="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Number" Name="sort_order" StaticName="sort_order" DisplayName="sort_order" Description="Order in dropdowns." Required="FALSE" Decimals="0"/>
<Field Type="Boolean" Name="active" StaticName="active" DisplayName="active" Description="Inactive values are hidden from new entries." Required="FALSE"><Default>1</Default></Field>

body.Title: settings
body.Description: System settings that admins can change without editing flows.

body.Title: setting_key
body.Description: Setting name. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="setting_value" StaticName="setting_value" DisplayName="setting_value" Description="Value." Required="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Note" Name="description" StaticName="description" DisplayName="description" Description="What the setting does." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>

body.Title: audit_log
body.Description: Every create, edit and status change: who, when, old and new value. Written only by flows.

body.Title: audit_ref
body.Description: Reference. Flows use AUD- plus a GUID.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="list_name" StaticName="list_name" DisplayName="list_name" Description="List that changed." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="item_key" StaticName="item_key" DisplayName="item_key" Description="Key of the item that changed." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="action" StaticName="action" DisplayName="action" Description="create, edit, status_change, reopen or retire." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>create</CHOICE><CHOICE>edit</CHOICE><CHOICE>status_change</CHOICE><CHOICE>reopen</CHOICE><CHOICE>retire</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="Text" Name="field_name" StaticName="field_name" DisplayName="field_name" Description="Column that changed. Blank for create." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Note" Name="old_value" StaticName="old_value" DisplayName="old_value" Description="Value before." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>
<Field Type="Note" Name="new_value" StaticName="new_value" DisplayName="new_value" Description="Value after." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="changed_by" StaticName="changed_by" DisplayName="changed_by" Description="Who made the change." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="changed_at" StaticName="changed_at" DisplayName="changed_at" Description="When." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="DateTime"/>

body.Title: export_jobs
body.Description: Scheduled snapshot exports. Admins edit these; a flow runs them.

body.Title: job_code
body.Description: Key, e.g. EXP-FULL-NIGHTLY. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="job_name" StaticName="job_name" DisplayName="job_name" Description="Name." Required="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="dataset" StaticName="dataset" DisplayName="dataset" Description="full_model, measures, weekly_work or quarter_pack." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>full_model</CHOICE><CHOICE>measures</CHOICE><CHOICE>weekly_work</CHOICE><CHOICE>quarter_pack</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="format" StaticName="format" DisplayName="format" Description="csv, xlsx or both." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><Default>both</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>csv</CHOICE><CHOICE>xlsx</CHOICE><CHOICE>both</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="frequency" StaticName="frequency" DisplayName="frequency" Description="daily, weekly, monthly or quarterly." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>daily</CHOICE><CHOICE>weekly</CHOICE><CHOICE>monthly</CHOICE><CHOICE>quarterly</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="Number" Name="run_day" StaticName="run_day" DisplayName="run_day" Description="Weekly: 1 (Mon) to 7. Monthly or quarterly: day of month. Ignored for daily." Required="FALSE" Decimals="0"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="folder_path" StaticName="folder_path" DisplayName="folder_path" Description="Folder in the snapshots library." Required="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Boolean" Name="keep_history" StaticName="keep_history" DisplayName="keep_history" Description="Keep dated copies as well as /latest. Dated copies are always kept for now; automatic clean-up is a later feature." Required="FALSE"><Default>1</Default></Field>
<Field Type="Boolean" Name="active" StaticName="active" DisplayName="active" Description="Only active jobs run." Required="FALSE"><Default>1</Default></Field>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="last_run_at" StaticName="last_run_at" DisplayName="last_run_at" Description="Written by the flow." Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="last_run_status" StaticName="last_run_status" DisplayName="last_run_status" Description="Written by the flow." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>

body.Title: export_requests
body.Description: Queue of exports. The apps and the scheduler add a row; the PMSExportRun flow picks it up, writes the files and fills in the link.

body.Title: request_ref
body.Description: Reference, e.g. REQ-20261001-0930-ab12. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Choice" Name="dataset" StaticName="dataset" DisplayName="dataset" Description="full_model, measures, weekly_work or quarter_pack." Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>full_model</CHOICE><CHOICE>measures</CHOICE><CHOICE>weekly_work</CHOICE><CHOICE>quarter_pack</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>
<Field Type="Text" Name="job_code" StaticName="job_code" DisplayName="job_code" Description="The export_jobs row that asked for it. Blank for on-demand exports." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Text" Name="quarter_label" StaticName="quarter_label" DisplayName="quarter_label" Description="For quarter packs: the financial quarter, e.g. 2026-27 Q2." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>

<Field Type="Note" Name="odata_filter" StaticName="odata_filter" DisplayName="odata_filter" Description="Optional filter applied to the dataset's main tables, e.g. financial_year eq '2026-27'." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>

<Field Type="Text" Name="filter_label" StaticName="filter_label" DisplayName="filter_label" Description="The filter in plain English, shown in the email and README." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="folder_path" StaticName="folder_path" DisplayName="folder_path" Description="Folder in the snapshots library." Required="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="requested_by" StaticName="requested_by" DisplayName="requested_by" Description="Who asked for it. Blank for scheduled jobs." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="requested_at" StaticName="requested_at" DisplayName="requested_at" Description="When it was asked for." Required="TRUE" Format="DateTime"/>

<Field Type="Choice" Name="status" StaticName="status" DisplayName="status" Description="queued, running, done or failed." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><Default>queued</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>queued</CHOICE><CHOICE>running</CHOICE><CHOICE>done</CHOICE><CHOICE>failed</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="Note" Name="output_url" StaticName="output_url" DisplayName="output_url" Description="Link to the folder holding the files." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>
<Field Type="Note" Name="message" StaticName="message" DisplayName="message" Description="What happened, including any error." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="completed_at" StaticName="completed_at" DisplayName="completed_at" Description="When it finished." Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime"/>

body.Title: rpt_values
body.Description: Flat, read-only reporting table: one row per approved measure per period with every lookup filled in. Rebuilt by flows; export straight from here.

body.Title: submission_key
body.Description: measure_code|period_key. Unique.

parameters.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="measure_code" StaticName="measure_code" DisplayName="measure_code" Description="Measure." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="measure_name" StaticName="measure_name" DisplayName="measure_name" Description="Measure name." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="source_ref" StaticName="source_ref" DisplayName="source_ref" Description="Source document reference." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="parent_measure_code" StaticName="parent_measure_code" DisplayName="parent_measure_code" Description="Parent measure." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="measure_class" StaticName="measure_class" DisplayName="measure_class" Description="measure, kpi or okr." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="measure_type" StaticName="measure_type" DisplayName="measure_type" Description="summary, output or outcome." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="category" StaticName="category" DisplayName="category" Description="Category code." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="unit" StaticName="unit" DisplayName="unit" Description="Unit." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="polarity" StaticName="polarity" DisplayName="polarity" Description="Polarity." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="frequency" StaticName="frequency" DisplayName="frequency" Description="Frequency." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="aggregation_method" StaticName="aggregation_method" DisplayName="aggregation_method" Description="How to roll up." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="owner_name" StaticName="owner_name" DisplayName="owner_name" Description="Measure owner." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="owner_email" StaticName="owner_email" DisplayName="owner_email" Description="Measure owner email." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="org_unit_key" StaticName="org_unit_key" DisplayName="org_unit_key" Description="Owning team." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="period_key" StaticName="period_key" DisplayName="period_key" Description="Period." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="period_type" StaticName="period_type" DisplayName="period_type" Description="Period type." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="period_label" StaticName="period_label" DisplayName="period_label" Description="Period label." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="period_start" StaticName="period_start" DisplayName="period_start" Description="Period start date." Required="FALSE" Format="DateOnly"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="period_end" StaticName="period_end" DisplayName="period_end" Description="Period end date." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" Format="DateOnly"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="financial_year" StaticName="financial_year" DisplayName="financial_year" Description="Financial year." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="financial_quarter" StaticName="financial_quarter" DisplayName="financial_quarter" Description="Financial quarter." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Number" Name="value_number" StaticName="value_number" DisplayName="value_number" Description="Approved value (not text measures)." Required="FALSE"/>
<Field Type="Note" Name="value_text" StaticName="value_text" DisplayName="value_text" Description="Approved value (text measures)." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>
<Field Type="Boolean" Name="value_missing" StaticName="value_missing" DisplayName="value_missing" Description="Yes if no value was provided." Required="FALSE"/>
<Field Type="Note" Name="narrative" StaticName="narrative" DisplayName="narrative" Description="Approved narrative." Required="FALSE" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="data_quality" StaticName="data_quality" DisplayName="data_quality" Description="Data quality flag." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="Number" Name="version_no" StaticName="version_no" DisplayName="version_no" Description="Approved version number." Required="FALSE" Decimals="0"/>
<Field Type="Text" Name="approved_by" StaticName="approved_by" DisplayName="approved_by" Description="Approver email." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255"/>
<Field Type="DateTime" Name="approved_date" StaticName="approved_date" DisplayName="approved_date" Description="Approval time." Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime"/>
<Field Type="Number" Name="target_value" StaticName="target_value" DisplayName="target_value" Description="Target for the period." Required="FALSE"/>
<Field Type="Number" Name="tolerance_value" StaticName="tolerance_value" DisplayName="tolerance_value" Description="Tolerance for the period (kpi and okr only)." Required="FALSE"/>

body.Title: snapshots
body.Description: Scheduled export files. /latest is overwritten each run; dated folders keep history.
